_comment: How each kind of printer treats the process settings that depend on the machine. Policies: 'printer' = the target profile applies, 'model' = the designer's value is kept. Rules for a printer model override those of its architecture. A rule is 'verified' only after converting and printing on that printer; otherwise reports say the rules are generic and ask for feedback. Contribute: docs/printer-rules.md.

single.notes: Multicolour projects need manual filament changes; the purge tower only matters if the user adds them.

filament_changer._detect: one nozzle fed by a filament changer (AMS, IFS, ACE, MMU): single_extruder_multi_material
filament_changer.notes: The old colour must be purged at every change: in the purge tower, or through a purge chute on printers that have one (Bambu).

toolchanger._detect: several extruders (independent toolheads, tool changers, IDEX)
toolchanger.notes: No colour purge between heads; idle heads may be cooled (ooze_prevention, standby_temperature_delta) and the tower primes the next head.

Flashforge Creator 5 Pro.verified: 2026-10-30, Flash Studio 1.7.20 profiles: purge tower from the printer (profile default on, ooze_prevention, standby −100 °C, purge_in_prime_tower off; the tower only primes the next head)
Flashforge Creator 5 Pro.notes: Turning the tower off is possible (no colour purge needed) at the risk of under-extrusion or strings after each head change.
